findings.title: Missing Machine-Readable Structured Data (JSON-LD)
findings.evidence: Found 0 valid <script type='application/ld+json'> blocks on https://github.com. AI search crawlers cannot deterministically extract entities or facts.

suggested_action.summary: Add Schema.org JSON-LD markup (Organization at minimum, plus Product/FAQPage/Article where relevant) so AI engines can extract unambiguous facts.

findings.title: Sitemap Not Found (/sitemap.xml Inaccessible)
findings.evidence: Could not locate a valid XML sitemap at https://github.com/sitemap.xml, https://github.com/sitemap_index.xml, or via robots.txt Sitemap: directives. Search bots cannot systematically discover refreshed URLs.

suggested_action.summary: Publish an XML sitemap at /sitemap.xml and reference it within robots.txt as 'Sitemap: https://.../sitemap.xml'.

findings.title: Intrusive Modal Overlay Detected on Initial View
findings.evidence: Detected full-screen popup/modal elements ([['logged-out', 'env-production', 'page-responsive', 'header-overlay', 'header-overlay-fixed', 'js-header-overlay-fixed'], ['logged-out', 'env-production', 'page-responsive', 'header-overlay', 'header-overlay-fixed', 'js-header-overlay-fixed']]) that may intercept visitors immediately upon arrival from AI search summaries.

suggested_action.summary: Suppress disruptive popups for users arriving from AI search referrers, or defer modal appearance until substantial scroll depth.

findings.title: Low Text-to-HTML Ratio (Excessive DOM Bloat)
findings.evidence: Visible body text is 0.79% of the HTML payload (4559 text chars vs 575927 HTML chars). Excessive markup impairs AI token-ingestion efficiency.

suggested_action.summary: Minify markup, externalise inline CSS/JS, and eliminate unnecessary nested wrapper divs to improve content density.
